channel.title: Sports Collectors Digest - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Sports Collectors Digest (sportscollectorsdigest.com)

item.title: Fake Dominique Wilkins autographs, 1990s Fleer Basketball cards targeted in new forgery scandal
item.description: A collector has uncovered another sports card forgery ring that allegedly has been selling forged autographs and fake cards from the 1991-92 Fleer Basketball set.

item.title: 1984 Michael Jordan Type 1 Original Photo headlines photo auction at Goldin
item.description: The Michael Jordan Jumpman image is one of the most famous logos in sports history. A Type 1 Original Photo from the 1984 Jumpman photo session is up for bid at Goldin.

item.title: John Elway, Bears, Cubs stars shine at Chicago Sports Spectacular
item.description: The Chicago Sports Spectacular featured some big-name autograph signers, from football Hall of Famers John Elway and Tony Dorsett to stars of the hometown Cubs and Bears.

item.title: SGA, Joker and Kon set card records in Goldin Elite Auction
item.description: Basketball card sales remain hot with NBA MVP Shai Gilgeous-Alexander, three-time MVP Nikola Jokic and rookie Kon Knueppel leading the way.

item.title: You can own a piece of the Goodyear Blimp as iconic tire company celebrates 128-year history
item.description: The Goodyear Blimp is synonymous with sports and big sports events. Now you can own a piece of the Blimp or a Goodyear Racing tire from the iconic company.

item.title: Tom Brady deals trash-talk and trading cards at Fanatics Fest reveal
item.description: Tom Brady had some fun with Eli Manning and Logan Paul as he revealed athletes who will appear at Fanatics Fest 2026. He also gave away some cool rookie cards.

item.title: Whatnot lawsuit could mean big trouble for breakers, help protect collectors
item.description: Whatnot is under fire after collectors allege the livestream shopping platform is engaging in gambling through its live pack breaks and trading card repacks.

item.title: Soccer fans, collectors can chase 2026 Panini World Cup stickers embedded in Coca-Cola products
item.description: Panini World Cup Stickers are among the most coveted soccer collectibles in the world. For the 2026 World Cup, fans and collectors can find Panini stickers in Coca-Cola products.

item.title: Undervalued Salvador Perez cards could spike after stirring WBC victory
item.description: Veteran catcher and future Hall of Famer Salvador Perez has some of the most undervalued cards on the market. His victory in the World Baseball Classic could change that.

item.title: 1952 Topps Mickey Mantle card tops six figures in REA auction
item.description: The iconic 1952 Topps Mickey Mantle card continues to produce eye-popping sales. A grade-3.5 Mantle sold for six figures at REA.
